data.name: Eleanor
data.gender_notes: Eleanor is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Greek eleos, 'compassion', or from the Provençal name Aenor. Its root is Greek eleos / Provençal Aenor. A medieval Christian name borne by queens and saints. Eleanor is a Greek name meaning “Light; (also) the other Aenor”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Eleanor expresses “Light; (also) the other Aenor”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Often derived from the Greek eleos, 'compassion', or from the Provençal name Aenor.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eleanor total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
